subject: Upcoming Travel Itinerary
body: Dear [Recipient], I hope this email finds you well. I wanted to send over the itinerary for our upcoming trip to Europe. We have booked flights for July 15th and will be staying at the Grand Hotel in Paris for the first three nights. From there, we will be taking the train to Rome and staying at the Colosseum Hotel. Please review the attached document for more details. Looking forward to our adventure! Best regards, [Your Name]
